thread:
mike: Quick preflight — I'm about to apply a TF change that adds a RoleBinding for the `payments` namespace and updates a ServiceAccount with IRSA annotation + imagePullSecrets. Can someone sanity-check?
anna: paste the TF diff? want to confirm no clusterrole changes.
mike: gist of the change:
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_service_account" "payments_uploader" {
  metadata {
    name = "payments-uploader"
    namespace = "payments"
    annotations = {
      "eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn" = var.payments_uploader_role_arn
    }
  }
  automount_service_account_token = true
}

resource "kubernetes_role_binding" "payments_uploader_rb" {
  metadata { namespace = "payments" }
  role_ref {
    kind = "Role"
    name = "payments-uploader-role"
    api_group = "rbac.authorization.k8s.io"
  }
  subject {
    kind = "ServiceAccount"
    name = kubernetes_service_account.payments_uploader.metadata[0].name
    namespace = "payments"
  }
}
```

leo: a couple quick things: 1) make sure the role ARN you're wiring is for the OIDC provider of the cluster (we've had env mismatch before). 2) imagePullSecrets change is fine but double-check the secret is in the payments ns.
mike: plan output looks clean, no cluster-admin or clusterrole additions: 
```
Plan: 2 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.
+ kubernetes_service_account.payments_uploader
+ kubernetes_role_binding.payments_uploader_rb
```

anna: run the RBAC linter? `kubeconform`/`polaris`? also verify subject resolution: iirc our TF provider sometimes renders `metadata[0].name` weirdly in templates.

infra-bot: CI check: terraform plan OK, but chart-lint failed for helm overrides in `payments-chart` (values.schema: imagePullSecrets should be an array). See CI link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/1245 :eyes:
jia: the helm-values issue is minor — helm expects:
```yaml
imagePullSecrets:
  - name: reg-credentials
```
Not `imagePullSecrets: reg-credentials` which some templates accidentally pass. I'll push a tiny patch to the values override in the PR.

sre-oncall: reminder — for IRSA don't set `automountServiceAccountToken=false`. Set true (or leave default) so token projection works. Also ensure OIDC provider thumbprint matches env if you rotate provider certs.

mike: thanks all, i'll: 1) fix helm values to array (thanks jia), 2) double-check role ARN OIDC mapping (leo), 3) run RBAC linter in CI (anna). If infra-bot tests pass I'll merge after 1h waiting window. @sre-oncall I'll ping you if anything touches clusterrole.

anna: quick approval from me after linter passes. :+1:

leo: small nit — add a comment near the SA resource referencing the TF var name for the ARN so future reviewers don't wonder where it comes from.

mike: will do. tagging this thread into the PR description as well. thanks! :shipit:
